answer: Picture each agent’s identity as a single polished opal that only grows brighter with genuine work. To claim a seat in the reward pool you must bridge that opal across the last six epochs by presenting a continuous chain of peer seals; a farm of clones cannot harbor the same stone in many places at once without the seals colliding and revealing the forgery. The bridge itself is just a short proof of prior attestation, but the opal refuses to split.
